name: Lanternline Rifle
rewardSource: The Gunsmith Below · find Tinker Wick near Owl’s Grotto in Mosswood
description: Hits spaced at least 0.55 seconds apart build focus, up to 18% extra damage against flanked or recovering enemies. A miss or rapid shot resets focus. Reinforce at any forge, up to +10; special-effect strength stays fixed.

name: Breachmaker Shotgun
rewardSource: Winter invasion · disrupt the siege with Medic Lumi
description: Within 150 steps, pellets deal 25% extra damage to shield and armored troops. A four-shell magazine and 2.5-second reload reward a planned retreat. Reinforce at any forge, up to +10; special-effect strength stays fixed.

name: Signalstorm Carbine
rewardSource: Orchard invasion · stand with Captain Saffron
description: Land four shots on the same foe within 2.5 seconds to mark it for 3 seconds. Marked foes take 8% more damage from all heroes and defenders. Missing resets your sequence. Reinforce at any forge, up to +10; special-effect strength stays fixed.

name: Last Watch Armor
description: A timely dodge near an incoming projectile readies a 35-damage ward for 2 seconds (8-second recharge). Completing a defense also readies it. Navy coat, brass plate and burgundy cape form one complete suit; no extra set pieces are required. Existing outfit reinforcement adds its normal health and protection; the special effect does not scale.
rewardSource: The Last Watch · find Warden Tallow at the ruined Stonecrest watchtower

name: Blackglass Pathfinder Armor
description: Dodging grants 12% faster walking for 2 seconds and shortens your next reload within 3 seconds by 20%. Lower protection rewards repositioning. Charcoal coat, violet pauldrons and scarf form one complete suit; no extra set pieces are required. Existing outfit reinforcement adds its normal health and protection; the special effect does not scale.
rewardSource: The Blackglass Trail · follow violet survey ribbons beyond Ember Rest

name: Winter’s Whisper
discoveryClue: Find Keeper Thistle at Rimeglass Reservoir in Frostmarch. Complete A Breath Beneath the Ice and return the recovered ice chamber.
description: Four accurate hits on one target freeze an ordinary foe for 1.1 seconds. Each target then resists another freeze for 4 seconds. Commanders are chilled instead of frozen. Reinforce at any forge up to +10; frost timing remains fixed.
rewardSource: Find Keeper Thistle at Rimeglass Reservoir in Frostmarch. Complete A Breath Beneath the Ice and return the recovered ice chamber.

name: Ember Bastion Armor
discoveryClue: Find Foreman Brindle at Cindercoil Foundry in Emberworks. Complete The Furnace That Wouldn’t Die and return the recovered forge core.
description: Taking actual health damage braces the suit: 20% less incoming damage for 2 seconds, with a 12-second recharge. Copper and obsidian plates with a crimson sash form one complete suit. This grants no healing or lasting immunity. Normal outfit reinforcement applies; special-effect values stay fixed.
rewardSource: Find Foreman Brindle at Cindercoil Foundry in Emberworks. Complete The Furnace That Wouldn’t Die and return the recovered forge core.

name: Galeweave Mantle
discoveryClue: Find Pilgrim Sora at Zephyr Reliquary in Reedwater. Complete The Wind Remembers and return its windwoven pattern.
description: Completing a reload readies your next shot or full shotgun volley for +20% damage within 3 seconds, and grants 15% faster walking for 2 seconds. Recharges in 8 seconds. An ivory/emerald coat with teal streamers forms one complete suit. Normal outfit reinforcement applies; special-effect values stay fixed.
rewardSource: Find Pilgrim Sora at Zephyr Reliquary in Reedwater. Complete The Wind Remembers and return its windwoven pattern.

name: Sea Beast Armor
discoveryClue: Find Diver Pearl at the Drowned Maw, east of Crownrest Haven in Sunken Crown Isles. Defeat Nacremaw the Great Kraken and turn in The Beast Beneath the Crown.
description: Kraken’s Grasp: land three separate firearm shots on the same foe to summon a spectral tentacle for 40 base damage with hero scaling and 1.5 seconds of chill; 6-second recharge. Tidal Escape: dodge leaves a small ink pool for 2 seconds that chills ordinary foes; 10-second recharge. Jagged shell pauldrons, dorsal fins and a luminous tentacle mantle form one wild trophy suit. Normal outfit reinforcement applies; special-effect values stay fixed.
rewardSource: Find Diver Pearl at the Drowned Maw, east of Crownrest Haven in Sunken Crown Isles. Defeat Nacremaw the Great Kraken and turn in The Beast Beneath the Crown.
